**Make It Your Own!**


Customization options are endless! Pair the pattern with your favorite hardware, create a custom carving pattern, or finish it with liquids of your choice!


****


**Indigo Laine & Co**


Rooted in South Texas, Indigo Laine is a women-led and operated leather goods
brand creating pieces that are meant to be used, kept, and carried for years. Every
product is designed and handcrafted in-house using full-grain leather made in the
USA, with a focus on thoughtful design, durability, and function. What started as a
single tote bag grew naturally through word of mouth, shaped by the people who
trusted it and came back for more.


Our pieces wear in, not out. We design products that feel familiar, like something
you already know and love, and become more personal over time
